g.text: What actually moves your failure rate
It slips 2.7× as often after 3–4 earlier mistakes as with no mistakes yet in the session (15.3% vs
→ When mistakes start piling up, start a fresh session instead of pushing on.
It slips 2.7× as often at 60–80% context fill as at 0–20% context fill (11.7% vs 4.3%).
→ Compact or start fresh before the context reaches 60–80%.
It slips 1.8× as often at night (0–6h) as in the evening (18–24h) (9.4% vs 5.1%).
→ Save risky changes for the evening, when it holds up best — and be wary of the night.
Association, not causation. Ordered factors compare their two ends; categories compare the best
against the worst. ● clear = ranges don't overlap, ◐ maybe = they do.
